splits.final_reporting: one sealed test campaign after all selections, operating points, and calibrations are frozen

supervision.scenario_cycles: All nine TRAIN conditions and all four measured phases; route labels and private simulator state are never model inputs.

diffusion.budget_reason: The frozen large adaptive denoiser reached its best development profile within this 1,000-pass budget.

autoregressive.budget_reason: Equal-exposure comparison: the autoregressive density model is capped at the Diffusion/DiT budget of 1,000 nominal TRAIN presentations.

cvae.budget_reason: The frozen large CVAE design receives 2.5 times its longest preliminary exposure and 1,000 passes over retained TRAIN windows.

flow_matching.budget_reason: The frozen large vector-field design receives five times its longest single preliminary fit and 1,000 passes over retained TRAIN windows.

evaluation.wrong_tilt_policy: one of the other two lateral labels, deterministically balanced by layout and evaluation seed
evaluation.test_repetition: One sealed campaign per selected seed-13 fit contains the same nine fixed physical cases crossed with ten prespecified proposal RNG seeds: 90 paired episodes per arm and family. Each proposal RNG seed is a repeated locked trial across all nine fixed cases; interrupted work resumes committed records with the same identities.

uncertainty.training_scope: One predeclared full fit per family (seed 13); no retraining-variation confidence interval is claimed.
uncertainty.primary_behavior: Report a deterministic 20,000-draw percentile block bootstrap over the ten locked proposal-trial seeds. Each resampled trial retains all nine fixed physical cases, so cases remain fixed.
uncertainty.paired_behavior: For reuse-versus-every-step and wrong-versus-correct tilt, preserve matched case and proposal RNG seed; bootstrap paired row-wise differences by locked proposal-trial seed while retaining all nine cases in each sampled block.
uncertainty.single_arm_behavior: Report the fixed-case repeated-trial bootstrap as the primary 95% interval and the exact episode-level binomial interval as a supplemental sensitivity summary.
uncertainty.prediction_and_proposals: Report the complete fixed snapshot, branch, and raw proposal panels for seed 13. Do not create a retraining confidence interval from candidates, overlapping windows, or predictive samples.
uncertainty.scope: Intervals quantify proposal-sampling trial variation for the seed-13 implementations conditional on the same nine fixed physical conditions; they do not quantify retraining variation or generalization to unseen environments.

qualification_policy: All four families run and remain in tables and figures regardless of preliminary or development qualification.
weak_model_policy: No architecture, optimizer, budget, operating-point, or checkpoint-rank tuning after this freeze.
precision: FP32 parameters and loss with TF32 training matrix products; synchronized FP32 evaluation with TF32 disabled

training_budget_policy.rule: No comparison model may receive more sampled training windows than Diffusion/DiT. Every full E1 fit receives exactly 53,705,000 sampled windows (1,000 nominal TRAIN presentations).
